description: $0.0025 — Session-death survival pack — checkpoint a lane's JSON state AND anchor its sha256 in the append-only receipt ledger in one call. Use when your session might die before the next task: resume via checkpoint, prove integrity via anchor (legs checkpoint_save + anchor_hash, bundle is 17% cheaper). Args: lane (required), state (required, ≤32KB JSON), tag, name. Returns {hash, checkpoint, anchor} with verify URLs.
name: persist_bundle
